title: BONDED SUBSTRATE, SURFACE ACOUSTIC WAVE ELEMENT, SURFACE ACOUSTIC WAVE ELEMENT DEVICE AND METHOD FOR MANUFACTURING BONDED SUBSTRATE
abstract: To reduce the propagation attenuation of a surface acoustic wave to propagate the surface acoustic wave.SOLUTION: The bonded substrate includes a quartz crystal substrate cut at an angle intersecting the crystal X-axis and a piezo-electric substrate laminated on the quartz crystal substrate. The cut angle of the quartz crystal substrate is preferably in a range of 85-95 degrees to the crystal X-axis; the surface acoustic wave propagation direction of the quartz crystal substrate has preferably an angle of 15-50 degrees to the crystal Y-axis; lithium niobate or lithium tantalate is preferably used as the piezo-electric substrate; and the piezo-electric substrate preferably has a relationship that the thickness h is 0.02-0.11λ to the wavelength λ of the surface acoustic wave.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
